house.description: Minor league baseball players exempted from minimum wage and overtime requirements.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

additions: (20) any individual who has entered into a contract to play baseball at the minor league level and who is compensated pursuant to the terms of a collective bargaining agreement that expressly provides for wages and working conditions.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
